title: Arriving by train and finding Pristler at the cafe
summary: Asked about a show billed as a jazz band, he tells of getting off a train and being sent by cab to a cafe where Pristler was.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: This show you were talking about, they advertised it as a jazz band, do you say?

No, I want to try to get it right. So, when we got off the train, we told the police we were waiting for Mike Pristler, so you ain't gonna catch Mike around here this time, they'd be seeing you fellas catch a cab. Go out to the El Sonny Cafe, the cab driver knows right where to go, so we went out there and George Pristler was there, he was in a colored polo.
